subtitle: AI Systems and experiments I've built end-to-end.

items.name: Deepfake Video Detection System
items.description: Deepfake detection web app — face-focused pipeline with 0.85 ROC-AUC and 0.95 recall.
highlights: Developed a Deepfake Video Detection web application using TensorFlow/Keras, OpenCV, Flask, and Gunicorn, achieving 0.85 ROC-AUC, 0.95 recall, and 0.92 F1-score for high-confidence video authenticity classification.

Engineered a computer-vision pipeline (YuNet face detection, InceptionV3 transfer learning, 2-layer GRU model) that lifted performance ROC-AUC from 0.59 to 0.85 via face-cropped frames, validated by cross-validation.
Implemented a deepfake video detection pipeline to generate confidence-scored authenticity predictions.

items.name: US Visa Approval Prediction System
items.description: End-to-end ML system predicting US visa approval outcomes across 25,000+ applications.
highlights: Developed a modular, end-to-end machine learning system for over 25,000 US visa applications. Integrated data validation quality protocols, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.
Enhanced an XGBoost classifier through hyperparameter tuning and probability threshold optimization, achieving a 91.83% recall, 73.07% precision, 81.39% F1-score, and 71.94% accuracy using MLflow.
Built Dockerized FastAPI application with automated workflows for real-time US visa approval predictions.

items.name: Movie Recommendation System
items.description: Content-based movie recommender over 4,800+ films, serving top-5 picks via Streamlit.
highlights: Developed a Movie Recommendation System utilizing NLP feature engineering on over 4,800 movies. Integrated cast, crew, genres, plots, and overviews into feature vectors for personalized recommendations.

Utilized CountVectorizer and cosine similarity from scikit-learn to compute content similarity between movies, accurately delivering the top-5 most similar titles as ranked recommendations from aggregated feature vectors.
Created a Streamlit web app for instant personalized movie recommendations based on user-selected titles.
